pictures.name: The creek crossing
pictures.prompt: Redraw this game map as an isometric view: 16-bit pixel art in the style of Stardew Valley, the same place seen from above at an angle. Keep its layout: every building, wall, path, fence, water and open ground where the map has it, the same size and shape, in the same places relative to each other. Add nothing the map does not show. What is on it: A pale frozen creek cuts across the scene, its surface a dull grey-blue streaked with white. A low wooden bridge spans it, half swallowed by deep snowdrifts so that only its planks and low rails break the white. Around the crossing, drifts pile against a wrecked wooden cart lying overturned on the bank. Scattered bones, some half-buried, dot the snow near the bridge, and a single barrel stands upright at one end. A rough barricade of piled timber and debris blocks part of the approach, and a corpse lies sprawled in the snow beside it, dark against the white. Cold, flat winter light with faint blue shadows softens every edge. The ground: snow-covered country in winter. Full-bleed scene, atmospheric light.
